title: 第一卷 第1章 穿越第一卷 第2章 小叔想干什么
content_zh:
“乘风啊，你要媳妇不要？”
“你家里人都走了，我是你叔，给你做这个主，你大哥的女人就交给你照顾了。”
“你们本来就是一家人，你不管她谁管她？”
……
“李乘风，我是郑老爷家里干长工的，有个好事跟你说啊，这两天郑老爷想要纳妾，看上你嫂子了，入门就给十两银子，这可是难得的价钱。”
“别怪我没提醒你，黑河帮这个月的保家钱提到了一户100文，要是谁拿不出来，女人拉去卖窑子，男人打断了腿脚当乞丐！”
“嘿，那可说好了，郑老爷要下个月月初娶新妾，到时候我可上门找你。”
……
破木屋里，李乘风看着眼前的破木墙，摸着生疼的脑袋，有些发呆。
一幕幕画面在脑海之中闪烁，连带着记忆涌上，他不得不接受一件事。
“穿越了……”
回想起脑海中的地球记忆，李乘风眼睛睁大，用力从床上坐起来扭头观看四周房屋，破旧的木屋倒映在瞳孔里，床板吱扭出声。
李乘风眼睛错愕尚存，便猛地觉得一股记忆涌来。
这里是大庆朝，朝廷多生战事，粮价物价飞涨，除了那些老爷以外，平民百姓的日子一个比一个不好过。
而自己，是一个生活在被黑帮统治的县城底层居民，家里的情况非常糟糕，钱早被各种事情折腾花光，父亲感染恶疾而死，哥哥修河道被衙役打死，母亲伤心过度郁郁而终。
家里就只剩下自己和嫂子了……
老叔对他好，劝他把嫂子娶了好好过日子。
但是原身却被郑老爷家一个长工挑动，想把嫂子卖给郑老爷。
结果还在做把嫂子卖了赚十两银子的美梦，回来的路上就被人敲了闷棍，抢了他打短工的钱。
再醒来时，便是现在了。

片刻后，消化了原身记忆的李乘风眼神里流露出恍然之色，神色里控制不住地涌现了几分欣喜。
前世自己痴迷国术，从小就借助网络便利外加科学知识勤练武艺，打磨身体，却因为国术大多为杀人技，在法律和社会生存限制之下，就算天赋不错却也无用武之地，经常被指责耽误时间，嘲讽为人愚笨。
一生，也只在生命终结前出手了一次。
——拿着刀送了欺压家人的豪门全家下地狱，最后被一颗子弹终结了生命。
而现在，这个世界……
“武道强者可以断江开山，只要凝聚出气血，达到可以一拳打碎岩石的程度，就可以不交税，来钱的路子一大把，不劳作也可过人上人生活，而且以武力横行者，纵因仇杀人，也不会有丝毫挂碍。”
李乘风感受着原身记忆里关于这个世界的一切，又感受到这具才十六岁的身体，眼神里越发闪烁光彩。
一股鱼入大海之感豁然从心中生出。
在这个世界，杀了进他家里欺辱女子之人全家，不会受刑！
这个世界居然有如此神奇的武道！
“吱~”
李乘风正心中翻涌之际，房门忽然被人推开。
抬头一看，一个面容美艳，身段高挑，但是衣衫打满补丁的年轻女子推门走入，看到躺在床上的李乘风，眼神一喜。
“乘风，你醒了！”
李乘风看着这个只有二十岁，虽然因为吃的差而身形消瘦，却难言清秀，且皮肤很白的女子，瞬间认出了她。
正是自己的寡嫂，刘玉娘。
“乘风，头还疼不，哪个王八蛋打得你，下手这么狠！”
刘玉娘满脸心疼的走到床边将李乘风扶起来，张开双唇对着李乘风脑袋上吹了吹，皱着眉头，双手轻柔的摸了摸他脑袋上的伤口。
content_en:
"Chengfeng, do you want a wife or not?"
"Everyone in your family is gone. I am your uncle. I will be in charge of you. Your eldest brother's woman will be taken care of by you."
"You are a family. If you don't care about her, who will care about her?"
…
"Li Chengfeng, I am a long-term worker in Master Zheng's family. I have a good thing to tell you. Master Zheng wants to take a concubine in the past two days and has fallen in love with your sister-in-law. He will give you ten taels of silver to get started. This is a rare price."
"Don't blame me for not reminding you. The Heihe Gang's guarantee money for this month is 100 yuan per household. If anyone can't come up with it, the woman will be sold in a brothel, and the man will have his legs broken and become a beggar!"
"Hey, it's settled. Master Zheng is going to marry a new concubine at the beginning of next month. I can come to see you then."
…
In the broken wooden house, Li Chengfeng looked at the broken wooden wall in front of him and touched his sore head, feeling a little dazed.
Scenes of scenes flashed in his mind, along with memories, and he had to accept one thing.
"Through time..."
Recalling the memory of the earth in his mind, Li Chengfeng's eyes widened. He sat up from the bed and turned to look at the surrounding houses. The dilapidated wooden house was reflected in his pupils, and the bed board creaked.
Li Chengfeng's eyes were still stunned, and he suddenly felt a rush of memories.
This is the Daqing Dynasty. There are many wars in the court, and food prices are soaring. Except for those lords, the lives of ordinary people are getting harder and harder.
And I am a low-income resident living in a county ruled by gangs. The situation at home is very bad. All my money has been spent on various things. My father died of a serious disease, my brother was beaten to death by a government officer while building a river, and my mother died of sadness and depression.
Only myself and my sister-in-law are left at home...
The old uncle was kind to him and advised him to marry his sister-in-law and live a good life.
However, the original person was provoked by a long-term worker of Mr. Zheng's family and wanted to sell his sister-in-law to Mr. Zheng.
As a result, he was still dreaming of selling his sister-in-law to earn ten taels of silver. On the way back, someone beat him up and robbed him of the money he had earned from working part-time.
When I woke up again, it was now.
After a while, Li Chengfeng's eyes showed a sudden look after digesting the memory of his original body, and he couldn't help but feel a bit of joy in his expression.
In my previous life, I was obsessed with Chinese martial arts. I used the convenience of the Internet and scientific knowledge to practice martial arts and polish my body since I was a child. However, because Chinese martial arts are mostly killing techniques, under the restrictions of law and social survival, even if I have good talent, there is no place to use it. I am often accused of wasting time and ridiculed for being stupid.
In my life, I only took action once before the end of my life.
——With a knife, he sent the wealthy family who oppressed his family to hell, and finally ended his life with a bullet.
And now, this world...
"A strong martial artist can break rivers and create mountains. As long as he can condense his energy and blood to the point where he can break rocks with one punch, he can make a lot of money without paying taxes. He can live a master's life without working. Moreover, those who use force can kill people for revenge without any worries."
Li Chengfeng felt everything about the world in his original memory, and felt this sixteen-year-old body, and his eyes became more and more shining.
A feeling of fish entering the sea suddenly emerged from my heart.
In this world, if someone kills someone who enters his home and bullies a woman, his whole family will not be punished!
There is such a magical martial arts in this world!
"Squeak~"
Just as Li Chengfeng's heart was churning, the door to his room was suddenly pushed open.
Looking up, a young woman with a beautiful face, tall figure and patched clothes opened the door and walked in. Her eyes lit up when she saw Li Chengfeng lying on the bed.
"Chengfeng, you wake up!"
Li Chengfeng looked at this woman who was only twenty years old. Although she was thin due to poor food, she was not delicate and had very fair skin, and he recognized her instantly.
It was his widowed sister-in-law, Liu Yuniang.
"Chengfeng, does your head still hurt? What bastard could beat you so hard!"
Liu Yuniang's face was filled with distressHe walked to the bed and helped Li Chengfeng up, opened his lips and blew on Li Chengfeng's head, frowned, and gently touched the wound on his head with both hands.
